entities.name: Al-Akhfasy Al-Ausath

entities.summary: Abū al-Ḥasan Saʿīd ibn Masʿadah al-Akhfash al-Awsaṭ, often shortened to Akhfash al-Awsaṭ, was an early Arabic grammarian, linguist, and scholar of maʿānī al-Qurʾān. He died approximately in 215 AH.
